name: Spread of iron smelting
short_desc: Iron smelting becomes established across parts of the eastern Mediterranean and western Asia.
date_note: Approximate coordinate near the end of the second millennium BCE. The first smelting of iron is uncertain; earlier iron objects could use meteoritic metal, and this is not an assertion of one inventor or universal start.
notes: Initial article identity, date meaning and source review completed. Summary authored for this catalog; independent claim-specific citations remain open.
